data.notes: March 2026 leaned into Aspen’s late-season ski-party energy, with strong electronic bookings at Belly Up Aspen and on-mountain après concerts around Snowmass.

events.title: GoldFish Live at The Cabin
events.summary: South African duo GoldFish brought their house-driven live-electronic setup to The Cabin on Snowmass for a free mid-mountain concert presented with Belly Up Aspen.

events.title: Vintage Culture
events.summary: Brazilian electronic headliner Vintage Culture played Belly Up Aspen with support from Doozie. The show was listed as a 21+ event with a 9:00 pm show time.

events.title: CloZee
events.summary: French bass-music producer CloZee headlined Belly Up Aspen with Orenda opening. The event was confirmed by the venue for Friday, March 13, 2026.

events.title: Beats Antique
events.summary: Beats Antique brought its theatrical world-fusion electronic show to Belly Up Aspen with Philia on support. The venue listed doors at 7:30 pm and show at 8:30 pm.

events.title: An Evening With Matisyahu
events.summary: Matisyahu played a stripped-back evening at Belly Up Aspen, with the venue billing the show for Wednesday, March 18, 2026. The program highlighted songs from Live at Stubb’s, Ancient Child, and fan favorites.

events.title: Zeds Dead
events.summary: Canadian electronic duo Zeds Dead headlined Belly Up Aspen as a 21+ late-night event. AXS listed the show for Friday, March 20, 2026 at 10:00 pm.

events.title: An Evening w/ Gary Clark Jr
events.summary: Grammy-winning guitarist and vocalist Gary Clark Jr played Belly Up Aspen on March 23. The venue listed the performance as an all-ages show with a 9:00 pm start.

events.title: Vandelux
events.summary: Electronic artist Vandelux played a sold-out 21+ show at Belly Up Aspen with Tyler Mann opening. The venue listed doors at 8:30 pm and show at 9:30 pm.

events.title: Spring Jam
events.summary: Aspen Snowmass’s 25th Spring Jam returned March 27–29 with competitions, downtown concerts, parties, Hi-Fi Concert Series programming, and late-night KickAspen skiing.

events.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong
events.summary: Baltimore jam-funk band Pigeons Playing Ping Pong closed out the month at Belly Up Aspen with Jewel House opening. The venue listed the March 29 show for 8:00 pm.
